entries.title: APT lock blocks package provisioning
entries.root_cause: An unattended apt process holds the dpkg frontend lock when Ansible tries to install the rampart packages. Provisioning must wait for the other package operation to finish before installing.

entries.title: Privilege escalation requires a password
entries.root_cause: The provisioning account cannot run sudo without a password and Ansible has no become password. Configure passwordless escalation for the account or provide the become password.

entries.title: Template source is missing
entries.root_cause: The rampart configuration task references a template source that is absent from the role's template search paths. Restore the template or correct the source path.

entries.title: APT lock blocks package provisioning again
entries.root_cause: An unattended apt process holds the dpkg frontend lock when Ansible tries to install the rampart packages. Provisioning must wait for the other package operation to finish before installing.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses a different runner and target, includes a directory task and uses diff mode; a different unattended-upgrades process owns the same lock.
